book.title: Cama Tsǝtsǝfǝ Nǝ Bulusu Nǝ Mǝthlǝu Anǝ Timathlawusu

content: Soja Nǝ Kǝrsiti Kǝra Nju Fiyafǝ Ni
Nagǝ tsu zǝr ɗa, ga ɗa nǝnau lagu mayiwakur nǝ Hyal kǝra aˈyi wu Kǝrsiti Yesu.
Patǝr sǝra gǝ nggari ya vǝr na wu mwar sakida gangǝu, ga highiɓǝr nyi anǝ njira nju fiyafǝ ǝnga nda aga nda highiɓǝr anǝ alenyi nji.
Ar viya soja tsapǝu nǝ Kǝrsiti Yesu, ga sǝsǝˈwuri ɓwaɓwatǝ ǝnga ˈya.
Soja kǝra a vǝr mǝl thlǝr nyi aˈyi a kyaga fuwa kǝrnyi wu vanyi thlǝr mai, ama wu ɗǝfuwa ja, ja pina huɗa ndǝra dǝgal a dar kǝra ja.
Abangǝ tsu, lagur pǝra pǝra nǝ hwi, ndǝr sǝmku nuba nǝ hwi aˈyi mai, kǝl ma ji hwi tsaˈa ǝnga sǝr ɓǝla nǝ hwiya nyi na.
Ndǝr zǝwa ǝnga jiri, naja nga kyaga dzǝguya sǝm sǝr huɗa fa nyi nǝ tanggǝrma.
Ga ɗǝnga sǝˈyar kǝ ya vǝr na kau, arya Hyal ngu nda nǝ ngǝ nggabiya nda patǝu.
Ga ɗǝngari ǝnga Yesu Kǝrsiti, sara wu culi gǝ Dawuda, ndǝra hyaˈari sara vir tau. Najakǝ ngǝ ndǝshigu ɗa.
Arya ndǝshigu kau ǝnga ya vǝr sa ɓwaɓwatǝu, baˈanǝ shili ar mba ar sǝˈyi liyangǝ dǝgǝ ndǝ batal. Ama ndǝr sǝn mbiya ndǝr Hyal aˈyi mai.
Agabangǝ yi sǝsǝˈwuri sǝˈyar kǝ patǝ arya nji ɗǝɗǝm njir nu Yesu, aga nanda tsu nda uya mbǝɗau lagur Kǝrsiti Yesu ǝnga nda gu kadakadarkur nǝ baˈanuwa.
Kǝja ndǝr kǝra nja fiyafǝ ǝni.

content.text: mǝnu nda nggya ǝnga pi ǝnga ja.
Ma mǝn sǝsǝˈwuri ɓwaɓwatǝu arya ja,
mǝnu nda sǝm tǝlkur ǝnga ja.
naja ma ju nda kǝpalna sǝnǝ mǝn tsu.
Ma namǝn ngǝ nji kǝra ji gǝra fiyafǝ ni,
ama ju nggya ndǝra mǝnu fiyafǝ ni,
ara naja aˈyi ndǝr miya mǝthlǝ mai.

content: Ndǝr Mǝl Thlǝr Kǝra Hyal Fiyafǝ Nǝ
Ga dumwa ǝnga ɗǝngar nda sǝˈyar kau. Ga kughiya nda wu mwar Hyal ar kǝra shasha ndǝr abǝr aˈyi ǝnga akkǝri mai, ama kǝl ndza njira wu sǝhimi nda wacu.
Ga nǝrdzau aga ga cabiya kǝrngau anǝ Hyal ar viya ndǝr mǝl thlǝr kǝra Hyal dlǝwuri. Ga ɗa ndǝr mǝl thlǝr kǝra wu sǝn hǝbiya kǝrnyi sara wu sǝli wu mwar Hyal. Ga ɗa ndǝra wu sǝn highiɓǝri sǝra jiri.
Ga tǝkǝbiya dzau ǝnga ndǝr papatagǝu nǝ diɗa ndǝr Hyal, ara njira fuwa kǝrnda a gwagwa, ndu dumwa ǝnga maˈyi naɗǝu ǝnga gǝra hivǝr Hyal.
Highiɓǝr nda wu tǝtǝlnakǝr ǝnggǝr gyakǝma. Wu pama nda ngǝ culi nji ǝnggǝr Himaniyasu ǝnga Fǝlayitusu,
njira piyari lagu jiri. Ndu na abǝr hyaˈari sara vir tau a tǝrabiyari, lagu kau nga ndu ndzana mbǝrsa nǝ alenyi nji.

Alaga abangau fǝ hyi ɓaɓal nǝ Hyal a taˈyiri baˈanuwa. Hyal ǝnga kǝrnyi a fǝri mǝtsamǝ ar kǝra fǝ hyi ɓaɓal nyi kau, kǝra wu na, abǝr, “Thlagǝu wu sǝni njira nǝ nyi ngau,” ǝnga “Kalar ndǝra wu na abǝr naja nǝ Thlagǝu, kǝl ji piyari mǝl sǝra ɗǝmwaˈyu.”
Wu ki dǝgal ǝhya sǝm sau aˈyi kǝra nji mǝliya sara wu ǝndzau ǝnga thladla, alenyi tsu sara wu wu, ǝnga sara wu ˈyiˈyi tsǝkwaɓǝu. Alenyi nǝ mǝl thlǝr mǝnahǝu ǝnga alenyi tsu nǝ thlǝr kǝra didiɗi.
Ma ndǝra cina kǝrnyi sara ara sǝ didiɗiˈyar kau, ju ɗa kar thlǝr kǝra mǝnahǝu, kǝra cicau, kǝra ǝnga vala dzǝ anǝ thlagǝ nyi, kǝra nji mǝliya cipǝu aga mǝl kalar thlǝr kǝra tsapǝu.

Ga hwinakǝr naɗǝu sara ara sǝra wu dla ǝnga suna nǝ sǝsukur nǝ wazhakur. Ga fuwa kǝr wu gal sǝra wu dla ǝnga mǝnahǝkur, ǝnga mbǝrsa, ǝnga yiwudzau ba ǝnga jamǝkur daɓǝ ǝnga njira wu ngga thlǝmǝr Thlagǝu sara wu ɗǝfu pǝrtǝu.
A sara sa daɓǝr hyi ǝnga kǝpal nǝ kurthlǝ ǝnga ndǝr didiɗi mai, ara wu sǝni gau abǝr culi kau a dla ǝnga bwari wacu.
Aˈya kyaga mafa Hyal ja ɗa ndǝr bwari mai, ama ja kyaga ɗa ndǝr tǝhuɗǝu ǝgya kalar ndau, ǝnga ja ɗa ndǝr sǝn highiɓau ǝnga ndǝra gǝra ndzǝ ɗǝfu.
Njira wu kǝpal ǝnga ja, kǝl ja ndǝr anǝ nda ǝnga hangǝkal, tara ba Hyal a nǝ nda lagu nǝ tubi nda sǝnbiya lagu nǝ jiri.
Aga nda daɓaga sha a shili wu hangǝkalǝr nda, aga nda biya sara wu lǝbam nǝ shatan, ndǝra mbar nda aga nda mǝl sǝra ju yiwu.
